WITH RECURSIVE reach(src, dst, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT e.src, e.dst, 1, ARRAY[e.src::text, e.dst::text]
  FROM edges e
  WHERE e.dst IN ('org_a:ident:00003', 'org_a:ident:00005', 'org_a:ident:00006', 'org_a:secret:00001', 'org_a:secret:00002', 'org_a:secret:00004', 'org_a:secret:00006', 'org_a:ds:00001')
  UNION
  SELECT e.src, e.dst, r.depth + 1, r.path || e.src::text
  FROM edges e
  JOIN reach r ON e.dst = r.src
  WHERE r.depth < 6 AND NOT ((e.src::text) = ANY(r.path))
)
SELECT DISTINCT r.src, r.dst, e.type, e.props FROM reach r JOIN edges e ON r.src = e.src AND r.dst = e.dst;

WITH RECURSIVE reach(src, dst, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT e.src, e.dst, 1, ARRAY[e.src::text, e.dst::text]
  FROM edges e
  WHERE e.src = 'internet'
  UNION
  SELECT e.src, e.dst, r.depth + 1, r.path || e.dst::text
  FROM edges e
  JOIN reach r ON e.src = r.dst
  WHERE r.depth < 5 AND NOT ((e.dst::text) = ANY(r.path))
)
SELECT DISTINCT r.dst as asset_id, f.id as finding_id, f.scanner, v.cve, v.cvss, v.eps, v.kev 
FROM reach r
JOIN edges e_run ON e_run.src = r.dst AND e_run.type = 'RUNS'
JOIN edges e_has ON e_has.src = e_run.dst AND e_has.type = 'HAS_VULN'
JOIN vulns v ON v.id = e_has.dst
JOIN findings f ON f.id IN (SELECT id FROM findings WHERE id IN (SELECT finding_id FROM ...))
LIMIT 30;
